[[Rajazan's Fervor]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Cultist Rajazan]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:[[Energy]] +5

==Skin==
This item shares the same [[skin]] as the [[Broadsword]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[sword]]s:
**[[Katana]] from crafter [[Shichiroji]]
**[[Machete]] from collector [[Shashi]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
*[[Icy]] [[Sword Hilt]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sword Pommel]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR
*One of the following [[sword]]s:
**[[Machete]] from crafters [[Bolereh]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Long Sword]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hulen Hairyback]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Sword]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Sword]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Sword]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Envoy Sword]] from crafter [[Jessie Llam]]
**[[Norn Sword]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Sword]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Sword of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Turai's Sword]] from [[Durmand]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Charr Sword]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Mursaat Sword]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Sword]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Sword]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Icy]] [[Sword Hilt]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sword Pommel]] [[of Enchanting]]
*Perfect "[[I Have the Power!]]" inscription

==Note==
*The [[enchantment]]s and [[energy]] boost make this item (plus [[Little John]], [[Padraic]], [[Sharp Pointy Stick]], [[Spirit of the Forgotten]] and [[Totem Axe]]) especially popular among [[55 monk]]s/necromancers and [[Vow of Silence]] runners along with many other [[spellcaster]]s.

==Trivia==
*Although this is a sword and requires Swordsmanship attribute rank, it is dropped by a Necromancer boss.
